relations.text: 傘下のDominionHVとともに送電合弁Valley Linkの運営契約を結んだ

source.quote: On February 21, 2025, FET, DominionHV and Transource entered into the Valley Link Operating Agreement, which established the general framework for Valley Link and the Valley Link Subsidiaries to accept, design, develop, construct, own, operate and finance those transmission projects awarded by PJM to Valley Link.
